text: I don't have confirmed details on whether a free trial is currently offered, since promotions can vary over time. Albert's basic features, like budgeting and account monitoring, are free, while Genius is a paid subscription. Before you're charged, the pricing and any trial terms are shown on the subscription screen in the app, and you'll need to confirm there before you subscribe. If you'd like to double-check, you can also reach our support team through the app's Help section.
